claims.claim: UK used Canon EOS 600D Digital Camera very neat and sharp.
claims.evidence: Witness report identifies the readable model as Canon EOS 700D (photo 2), not 600D.
No shot in the witness report shows shutter count or a menu screen proving it.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show lenses attached and a second lens present, but do not show close-up inspection of lens glass for fungus/scratches.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: Witness report does not show included battery/charger or any repair/warranty documentation.

risks.risk: Model mismatch (seller says EOS 600D, witness reads EOS 700D). This affects value and buyer expectations.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera’s model name from the body/menu (e.g., “EOS 700D” shown on the camera or in the About/Model screen).
risks.if_unproven: Price as the identified model only (EOS 700D) and treat seller’s mismatch as a potential misrepresentation; do not pay a premium based on the wrong model claim.

risks.risk: Functional condition unknown (shutter, autofocus accuracy, buttons/ports, sensor health).
risks.proof: A short video test: autofocus on a moving subject, a few sample shots at different apertures, and a quick check of key buttons/ports (e.g., playback, menu, zoom, USB/AV if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case as a used camera with unknown working condition (assume may need service) until tests are shown.

risks.risk: Lens condition unknown beyond what’s visible (possible haze, fungus, scratches, or coating damage).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both lenses’ front and rear elements under bright light (including edges), plus a shot of a high-contrast test image (e.g., street lights/printed text) to reveal haze/fungus.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lenses with potential optical issues (no premium for “no fungus/no scratch”).

risks.risk: Accessories completeness unknown (battery, charger, caps, hood, cables, memory card).
risks.proof: A laid-out photo showing every included item (battery model, charger, caps, strap, any cables, memory card if included).
risks.if_unproven: Price as camera body + visible lens(es) only, without assuming charger/battery/memory card.

risks.risk: Shutter count claim may be inaccurate or not shown.
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo of the shutter count from the camera or a connected software readout.
risks.if_unproven: Price without relying on low shutter count (worst-case within typical used range).

risks.risk: Potential fraud/quality misrepresentation risk (seller claims “very neat and sharp” and specific low shutter count, but evidence is not shown).
risks.proof: Provide the exact shutter count screen and close-up lens inspection photos as above, plus a working test video.
risks.if_unproven: Price conservatively and require proof before paying near the top of the market.

proof_requests: Clear photo showing the exact camera model (EOS 700D) from the body or an on-screen “About/Model” page.
Screenshot/photo of shutter count (from camera menu or a shutter-count tool readout).
Close-up inspection photos of both lenses’ front and rear elements under bright light (edges included) to confirm no fungus/haze/scratches.
Short working test video: autofocus on a moving subject, a few sample photos, and quick demonstration of key buttons/ports.
Photo of all included accessories laid out (battery, charger, caps/hood, cables, and whether a memory card is included).
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies a Canon DSLR setup with an EOS 700D body and an EFS 18-55mm lens (plus another Canon lens). Seller claims about shutter count, lens cleanliness, and included accessories are not proven by the witness photos, so pricing should be conservative at worst-case until the requested proof is provided.
